title: Research on developing SERS substrates based on a ZnO porous membrane decorated with silver nanoparticles aimed at detecting low concentrations of Rhodamine B
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40846-40854
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06188A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thuy Ngoc Thuy Nguyen, Nhat Tam Ha Nguyen, Minh Khoi Tran, Hoai Nhan Luong, Le Thai Duy, Hien D. Tong, Thanh Truc Pham, Vinh Quang Dang
This study highlights the benefits of the ZnO porous membrane regarding the interaction time and photon scattering. The SERS mechanisms arises from (1) the SPR effect of Ag NPs and (2) the chemical interactions between ZnO and RhB.
